features.description: User login with username/password on login page
steps: Open `/login.html` and keep the default Login tab selected.
Enter a valid username and password.
Click the login submit button.
Verify redirect to `/` after successful authentication.
Verify auth token and user info are stored in local storage.

features.description: Login error handling for invalid credentials
steps: Open `/login.html` and stay on Login tab.
Enter an invalid password for an existing username.
Submit the form.
Verify an error message is displayed and no redirect occurs.
Verify no valid token is stored.

features.description: Open registration flow with username/password creation
steps: Open `/login.html` and switch to Register tab.
Enter a valid username (2-30 chars) and password (>=6 chars).
Submit registration.
Verify API returns success and user is redirected to `/`.
Verify token is stored and session starts immediately.

features.description: Client-side registration validation for username and password length
steps: Open Register tab on `/login.html`.
Enter username shorter than 2 chars or longer than 30 chars.
Enter password shorter than 6 chars.
Submit the form.
Verify form blocks submission and shows validation feedback.

features.description: Auth guard redirects unauthenticated users to login page
steps: Clear auth token from local storage.
Navigate to `/`.
Verify redirect to `/login.html`.
Repeat on `/admin.html` and verify same redirect behavior.

features.description: Authenticated user profile retrieval from `/api/auth/me`
steps: Login successfully and capture the Bearer token.
Call `GET /api/auth/me` with Authorization header.
Verify 200 response with user id, username, and admin flag.
Verify created_at field is present.

features.description: Logout clears local session and returns user to login page
steps: Login and enter the main app.
Click the logout icon in the header.
Confirm logout in the prompt.
Verify token/user/session keys are removed from storage.
Verify redirect to `/login.html`.

features.description: Mandatory prompt builder requires PERSONA, TASK, CONTEXT
steps: Open `/` after login.
Leave one required field empty and click Send.
Verify validation alert appears.
Fill all required fields and click Send again.
Verify request proceeds.

features.description: Structured prompt construction with optional FORMAT and REFERENCES sections
steps: Fill required fields plus optional FORMAT and REFERENCES fields.
Click Send.
Inspect the user message bubble content.
Verify sections appear in `[PERSONA]/[TASK]/[CONTEXT]/[FORMAT]/[REFERENCES]` format.

features.description: Typing indicator transitions to streamed assistant output
steps: Submit a valid prompt.
Verify assistant placeholder shows typing indicator immediately.
Wait for streamed content chunks.
Verify indicator is replaced by formatted assistant text.

features.description: Prompt form clear action resets fields and uploaded files
steps: Fill prompt fields and upload at least one file.
Click Clear.
Confirm the clear prompt.
Verify all textareas are empty and file previews are removed.

features.description: New Chat creates a fresh local session and clears prompt form
steps: Send at least one message in current session.
Click New Chat in header.
Verify messages area resets to landing state for new session.
Verify prompt fields are cleared and builder is expanded.

features.description: Conversation history is persisted locally and grouped by date
steps: Create multiple sessions by sending prompts on separate chats.
Open history sidebar.
Verify sessions are listed under Today/Yesterday/Earlier group headers.
Refresh page and verify sessions remain.

features.description: Session switching restores previous message timeline
steps: Create two sessions with distinct message content.
Open history sidebar and click the older session.
Verify messages panel renders that session history.
Switch back and verify second session remains intact.

features.description: Session deletion removes entry and updates active chat safely
steps: Open history sidebar with multiple sessions.
Delete a non-active session and confirm.
Verify it disappears from list.
Delete active session and verify app starts a fresh new session.

features.description: File upload supports click, drag-drop, and paste image workflows
steps: Click upload zone and select a valid image file.
Drag-drop a second valid file into zone.
Paste an image from clipboard while prompt builder is focused.
Verify all files appear in preview list with count updated.

features.description: Document extraction supports PDF, TXT, MD, DOCX before send
steps: Upload one file of each supported document type.
Wait for extraction progress to finish.
Verify document preview includes excerpt and character count.
Send prompt and verify request completes without type errors.

features.description: File constraints enforce max count, size, and supported MIME list
steps: Attempt to upload more than 5 files.
Verify max-file warning and extra files are rejected.
Attempt to upload unsupported type (e.g., `.zip`).
Verify unsupported-type warning.
Attempt >20MB file and verify size warning.

features.description: Prompt builder minimizes after successful send and expands on tap
steps: Send a successful prompt.
Verify bottom minimized prompt bar appears and form area hides.
Tap minimized bar or expand button.
Verify full prompt builder returns with focusable fields.

features.description: Usage counter updates and hides for unlimited/admin users
steps: Login as limited user and call `GET /api/extension/status` via UI load.
Verify header shows used/limit counter.
Login as admin or unlimited user.
Verify usage counter area is hidden.

features.description: Extension request modal supports pending-state and submission rules
steps: For limited user, open extension modal from usage area.
Submit reason shorter than 10 chars and verify validation error.
Submit valid reason and amount.
Re-open modal with pending request and verify pending notice state.

features.description: Skills manager supports search and category/tag filtering
steps: Open Skills modal.
Enter keyword in search input.
Select category and/or tag filters.
Verify server list updates to matching skills only.
Clear filters and verify full list returns.

features.description: Skills can be enabled/disabled and token warning reacts to total content
steps: Open Skills modal and toggle several skills on.
Verify badge count updates on Skills button.
Enable enough long skills to exceed warning threshold.
Verify token warning section appears.
Disable skills and verify warning hides.

features.description: AI skill generation starts from assistant response context
steps: Send a prompt and wait for assistant response.
Click "Build Skill from this Prompt" on assistant message.
Verify generation modal opens with loading state.
Verify preview fields are populated after generation.

features.description: Generated skill save persists metadata and content to server
steps: Generate a skill from an assistant response.
Edit name/description/category/tags/content in modal.
Click Save Skill.
Verify success message and modal close.
Re-open Skills modal and verify new skill appears.

features.description: Skill edit and delete flows update list immediately
steps: Open Skills modal and click edit on an existing skill.
Change fields and save.
Verify updated values in list.
Re-open edit modal and delete skill with confirmation.
Verify item is removed from list.

features.description: Skill export supports all skills and enabled-only bundle
steps: Open Skills modal.
Click Export All Skills and verify markdown download starts.
Enable subset of skills and click Export Enabled Skills.
Verify downloaded content includes only enabled skills.

features.description: Landing mission state appears when chat history is empty
steps: Open a brand new session with no messages.
Verify mission title and two descriptive lines appear.
Verify no model-choice cards are displayed.

features.description: Header action layout remains usable on mobile widths
steps: Resize viewport to <=480px.
Verify history/new chat/language/logout icons remain visible and clickable.
Verify tap targets remain usable without overlap.

features.description: Message bubble alignment and avatars distinguish user vs assistant
steps: Send one prompt and receive one assistant response.
Verify user bubbles align right with user avatar.
Verify assistant bubbles align left with assistant avatar.

features.description: Markdown formatting renders code blocks, inline code, bold, and italics
steps: Submit a prompt that returns markdown syntax.
Verify triple-backtick blocks render as `<pre><code>`.
Verify inline code, bold, and italic text render correctly.

features.description: Mobile prompt action buttons stack/full-width appropriately
steps: Resize to <=480px and open prompt builder.
Verify clear/send actions are easy to tap and fit width constraints.
Verify no horizontal overflow in form actions area.

features.description: Mobile textareas keep 16px input size to avoid iOS zoom
steps: Open app on iOS Safari or emulated mobile viewport.
Focus each prompt textarea.
Verify viewport does not auto-zoom during typing.

features.description: Modal layout respects safe areas and viewport height on mobile
steps: Open extension and skills modals on <=480px viewport.
Verify modal body scrolls when content is long.
Verify modal does not render off-screen behind browser UI bars.

features.description: History overlay closes sidebar when tapping outside
steps: Open history sidebar.
Tap/click overlay outside sidebar panel.
Verify sidebar closes and overlay disappears.

features.description: POST /api/auth/register creates account and returns JWT
steps: Send POST request to `/api/auth/register` with valid username/password.
Verify 201 response includes `token` and `user` payload.
Verify `isAdmin` defaults to false for normal users.

features.description: POST /api/auth/login authenticates existing account
steps: Send POST `/api/auth/login` with valid credentials.
Verify 200 response with token and user object.
Send invalid password and verify error response.

features.description: GET /api/auth/me returns authenticated user profile
steps: Call `/api/auth/me` with valid Bearer token.
Verify 200 and user fields: id, username, isAdmin, created_at.
Call without token and verify unauthorized response.

features.description: GET /api/chat/models returns ChatGPT-only model metadata
steps: Call `/api/chat/models` with valid token.
Verify models array is returned.
Verify entry id is `chatgpt` and model resolves to `gpt-5.2` default.

features.description: POST /api/chat streams SSE chunk/done/error events
steps: Send valid structured prompt to `/api/chat` with token.
Verify response content-type is `text/event-stream`.
Verify one or more `chunk` events are received.
Verify terminal `done` event includes usage object.

features.description: GET /api/extension/status returns usage + request metadata
steps: Call `/api/extension/status` with valid token.
Verify response contains usage counters and unlimited flag.
Verify pending request info is included when applicable.

features.description: POST /api/extension/request submits extension request
steps: Send reason and requested amount to `/api/extension/request`.
Verify success response and pending request creation.
Send invalid reason length and verify validation error.

features.description: POST /api/skills/generate returns AI-generated skill preview
steps: Send persona/task/context/answer payload to `/api/skills/generate`.
Verify success response with `skill` name/description/content.
Verify invalid payload returns validation details.

features.description: GET /api/skills supports list filters and pagination
steps: Call `/api/skills` with search, category, tag, enabled, page, and limit params.
Verify pagination metadata and filtered skill list are returned.

features.description: POST /api/skills creates persisted skill records
steps: Send valid skill payload to `/api/skills`.
Verify 201 response with saved skill metadata.
Verify invalid empty name/content is rejected.

features.description: GET /api/skills/:id returns full skill including content
steps: Create a skill and capture its id.
Call `/api/skills/:id`.
Verify content/source_prompt fields are present.

features.description: PUT /api/skills/:id updates editable skill fields
steps: Send update payload to `/api/skills/:id`.
Verify updated values are returned and persisted.
Verify invalid size constraints are rejected.

features.description: DELETE /api/skills/:id removes skill
steps: Delete an existing skill via `/api/skills/:id`.
Verify success response.
Verify subsequent fetch returns not found.

features.description: PATCH /api/skills/:id/toggle flips enabled state
steps: Call `/api/skills/:id/toggle` on existing skill.
Verify `enabled` boolean changes in response and list view.

features.description: GET /api/skills/export supports bundled and enabled-only exports
steps: Call `/api/skills/export?bundle=true` and verify single markdown blob response.
Call `/api/skills/export?enabled=true&bundle=true` and verify only enabled skills are included.

features.description: Category and tag endpoints power skill filters
steps: Call `/api/skills/categories/list`, `/api/skills/categories`, `/api/skills/categories/:id`, and `/api/skills/tags/list`.
Verify category creation/deletion and tag aggregation behavior.

features.description: GET /api/skills/enabled/list returns enabled skills for prompt prefixing
steps: Call `/api/skills/enabled/list` with token.
Verify only enabled skills are returned with full content.

features.description: Admin extension endpoints list/review requests
steps: As admin, call `/api/admin/extensions` with optional status filter.
Approve one request via `/api/admin/extensions/:id/approve`.
Reject another via `/api/admin/extensions/:id/reject`.
Verify request state transitions and audit fields.

features.description: Admin users endpoint returns usage overview
steps: As admin, call `GET /api/admin/users`.
Verify each user row includes usage counts/limits and account metadata.

features.description: Admin invite endpoints support create/list/delete
steps: As admin, call `POST /api/admin/invites` with count 1-50.
Call `GET /api/admin/invites` and verify created codes appear.
Delete an unused code via `DELETE /api/admin/invites/:id` and verify success.

features.description: JWT authentication blocks missing token on protected routes
steps: Call protected endpoint without Authorization header.
Verify unauthorized response and no protected data leakage.

features.description: JWT verification blocks invalid/expired tokens
steps: Call protected endpoint with malformed or expired token.
Verify 403 response with invalid token error.

features.description: Admin authorization blocks non-admin access to admin routes
steps: Call `/api/admin/*` routes with a non-admin token.
Verify forbidden response for admin endpoints.

features.description: Usage-limit middleware blocks chat when quota is exhausted
steps: Use a limited user at quota boundary.
Call `POST /api/chat` after limit is reached.
Verify 403 `usage_limit_exceeded` payload with usage counts.

features.description: Rate limiting protects API and chat endpoints
steps: Burst requests beyond configured thresholds (60/min API, 20/min chat).
Verify rate-limit error responses appear once thresholds are exceeded.

features.description: Chat file validation enforces mime, size, and structure constraints
steps: Submit file payload with invalid MIME types and oversized base64 payload.
Verify invalid files are ignored/rejected by backend sanitization.
Verify only allowed types are forwarded to AI service.

features.description: Skill generation endpoint has per-user limiter
steps: Call `/api/skills/generate` repeatedly with same user.
Verify limiter response after 10 requests/hour for non-admin users.

features.description: Input length limits protect prompt and skill persistence
steps: Submit oversized chat message/history and oversized skill fields.
Verify message/history are truncated safely and skill validations reject over-limit values.

features.description: Admin panel fetches extension stats and request list
steps: Login as admin and open `/admin.html`.
Verify stats cards and request list load from `/api/admin/extensions`.

features.description: Admin can filter extension requests by status tabs
steps: Open admin page and switch between pending/approved/rejected/all filters.
Verify list updates according to selected status filter.

features.description: Admin approve flow grants finite prompt amount
steps: Open a pending request in admin panel.
Approve with numeric grant amount.
Verify requester usage_limit/remaining is updated accordingly.

features.description: Admin approve flow grants unlimited access
steps: Approve a pending request as unlimited.
Verify requester `is_unlimited` becomes true and limit checks are bypassed.

features.description: Admin reject flow stores response message
steps: Reject a pending extension request with optional admin response.
Verify status changes to rejected and response text is stored/displayed.

features.description: Admin can view user usage overview list
steps: Load admin users view/data.
Verify each row includes username, usage_count, usage_limit, and unlimited/admin flags.

features.description: Manifest enables installable standalone app shell
steps: Open `manifest.json` and verify name, short_name, start_url, display, and icon entries.
Trigger browser install flow and verify app can be added to home screen.

features.description: Service worker registers on app load
steps: Open `/` in supported browser with devtools Application tab.
Verify `sw.js` is registered and active for site scope.

features.description: Service worker cache warm-up stores app shell assets
steps: Install/open app online once.
Inspect cache storage for app shell entries (HTML/CSS/JS/icons).

features.description: Service worker bypasses API caching and uses network-first for core assets
steps: Call `/api/*` endpoints while observing service worker fetch handling.
Verify API responses are not cached.
Verify HTML/CSS/JS requests prefer network and update cache on success.

features.description: Service worker update flow triggers skip-waiting and controlled reload
steps: Deploy an updated `sw.js` version.
Verify waiting worker receives `SKIP_WAITING` message.
Verify page reloads after `controllerchange` once new worker activates.

features.description: Language detection initializes zh-CN or en-US and persists choice
steps: Clear `language` in local storage.
Load page with zh browser locale and verify Chinese default.
Switch language and reload page.
Verify selected language persists.

features.description: Language toggle updates visible labels and placeholders in real time
steps: Click language toggle on main app.
Verify header labels, button texts, placeholders, and mission copy update without reload.

features.description: Template interpolation supports parameterized translated strings
steps: Trigger UI that uses variable placeholders (e.g., file count / import/export messages).
Verify translated strings interpolate dynamic values correctly.

features.description: Localized page titles update through i18n binding
steps: Switch language on login and app pages.
Verify document title updates according to `data-i18n` title keys.

features.description: Local server serves static assets and SPA fallback for non-API paths
steps: Start `server/index.js` locally.
Request `/`, `/login.html`, and unknown non-API path.
Verify static assets are served and SPA fallback returns index for non-API routes.

features.description: Vercel serverless entry mounts same route set as local server
steps: Inspect `api/index.js` routing table.
Verify auth/chat/admin/extension/skills routes are mounted consistently.

features.description: MongoDB connection initializes once and is reused in serverless handler
steps: Inspect `ensureDBConnection` flow in `api/index.js`.
Verify connection guard avoids repeated initialization on warm invocations.

features.description: Environment defaults enforce ChatGPT-only model configuration
steps: Inspect `env.example` and `server/config.js`.
Verify only `OPENAI_API_KEY` and `OPENAI_MODEL` are required for AI runtime.

features.description: ChatGPT-only runtime selection with default `gpt-5.2` model
steps: Call `/api/chat/models`.
Verify only `chatgpt` provider/model is exposed.
Verify default model value resolves to `gpt-5.2` unless overridden.

features.description: OpenAI chat streaming handles text, extracted documents, and image attachments
steps: Send chat with document extractedText and image base64 payload.
Verify backend formats final user message with document context and image_url entries.
Verify stream returns completion chunks.

features.description: Skill generation uses prompt + model answer context
steps: Call `/api/skills/generate` with persona/task/context/answer.
Verify generated markdown includes name/description and reusable skill instructions.

features.description: Enabled skills are prepended as `[SKILLS]` prefix before prompt send
steps: Enable multiple skills in Skills modal.
Send prompt and inspect user message payload locally.
Verify `[SKILLS]` section appears before structured prompt blocks.

features.description: Generated skill save stores source_prompt metadata for traceability
steps: Generate a skill from assistant response and save it.
Fetch saved skill via `/api/skills/:id`.
Verify `source_prompt` metadata is present.

features.description: Skill generation validation requires meaningful persona/task/answer content
steps: Send `/api/skills/generate` request with short persona/task/answer values (<10 chars).
Verify validation errors specify missing/insufficient fields.

categories.functional: Core user workflows and business logic
categories.security: Authorization, rate limiting, and validation controls
categories.deployment: Runtime wiring, environment, and hosting setup
